summary: Zeta Global Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering issuance of up to $1.25 million of Class A common stock to a service provider in lieu of cash for services, plus resale registration of 287,711 shares held by selling stockholders who received them in the Senso.ai Inc. acquisition. Issuance price is set by a five-day VWAP preceding each payment date over several quarters; last sale was $33.55 on October 15, 2026. Zeta bears registration costs and receives no resale proceeds. Structurally this is an ordinary at-market equity issuance and resale shelf, not a special situation; watch modest dilution and selling-stockholder overhang.
